newsitem.title: USA: FDA ups shelf life for Integra skin product.
newsitem.headline: FDA ups shelf life for Integra skin product.

text.p: Integra LifeSciences Corp said Friday that the US Food and Drug Administration has approved its PMA supplement for a 24-month expiration date for Integra Artificial Skin.
The medical device, which received its first PMA approval from the FDA in March 1996, formerly had an expiration date of twelve months said Integra.
The company said the extension on the shelf life would improve its ability to meet the needs of its international distributors with less risk of expiration problems.

Integra Artificial Skin is the first of a series of products, said the company, that it is developing to regenerate a variety of body tissues, including articular cartilage and peripheral nerves, which ordinarily do not regenerate themselves.
